_comment: MSIX package identity. Copy the three values from Partner Center > your app > Product management > Product identity (Package/Identity/Name, Package/Identity/Publisher, Package/Properties/PublisherDisplayName). display_name must be the app name reserved in Partner Center. Until then these placeholders build a package that installs only for local testing; the Store rejects it.
name: VidovicsGabor.ClaudeUsageMonitor
description: Always-on-top panel that shows how much of your own Claude subscription is used: the 5-hour and weekly limits, per-model limits, reset times, pace and notifications. Free, open source, no telemetry.
